answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1751 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the vault. The onyx index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the wander queue while honest agents promoted earlier still earns. Honest users pay that once, farms 37 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
